why: Non-acetone remover takes off polish without quickly softening many nail tips and enhancements. Acetone can damage or loosen some enhancement products.
non-acetone remover（无丙酮卸甲液）可去除甲油，又不会迅速软化许多甲片和人工甲产品。丙酮可能损坏或松动某些产品。
lock: tips or enhancements = use non-acetone polish remover.
甲片或人工甲 = 使用无丙酮卸甲液。

why: Effleurage uses smooth, gentle strokes that glide over the skin. These strokes help the client relax and begin or end a massage.
effleurage（轻抚法）用平稳、轻柔的滑动动作按摩皮肤，帮助客户放松，也常用于按摩的开始或结束。
lock: effleurage = gentle gliding strokes.
effleurage = 轻柔滑动。

why: Dry toenails are easier to see and control with a file. Filing wet, softened nails can tear or split them.
干燥的脚趾甲更容易看清并控制甲锉。湿软的脚趾甲在修锉时可能撕裂或分层。
lock: file toenails when they are dry.
脚趾甲干燥时再修锉。

why: Nail polish remover contains a liquid that dissolves the dried polish film. This lets the color wipe away without scraping the nail.
卸甲液含有能溶解干燥甲油膜的液体，使颜色可以擦掉，不必刮伤指甲。
lock: polish remover dissolves the polish film.
卸甲液会溶解甲油膜。

why: Warm water softens dry foot skin and makes dead surface buildup easier to remove. Soaking also prepares the feet for the service.
温水能软化足部干燥皮肤，使表面死皮更容易去除，也为后续足部护理做好准备。
lock: foot soak = soften skin before care.
泡脚 = 护理前软化皮肤。

why: Petrissage is a kneading movement that lifts, squeezes, and presses soft tissue. It is deeper than the light strokes of effleurage.
petrissage（揉捏法）会提起、挤压并按压软组织，比 effleurage 的轻柔滑动动作更深。
lock: petrissage = kneading; effleurage = gliding.
petrissage = 揉捏；effleurage = 轻抚滑动。

why: Keeping the toenail edge mostly straight reduces pressure at the corners. Deeply rounding the corners can encourage the nail to grow into skin.
脚趾甲边缘保持基本平直，可减少两侧角落的压力。把角落剪得太圆，可能让指甲长进皮肤。
lock: toenails = trim mostly straight across.
脚趾甲 = 基本平直横剪。

why: A straight toenail edge leaves the side corners visible instead of cutting them deep. This helps prevent painful ingrown nails.
脚趾甲横向平剪可保留两侧角落，不会剪得过深，有助于防止疼痛的嵌甲。
lock: straight toenail edge helps prevent ingrown nails.
脚趾甲平直边缘有助于防止嵌甲。

why: File a toenail straight across, then soften the sharp corners slightly. Filing deep into the sides can injure skin and promote an ingrown nail.
脚趾甲应横向平直修锉，再轻轻磨圆尖角。深入两侧修锉可能伤到皮肤，并促成嵌甲。
lock: file toenails straight; soften corners only slightly.
脚趾甲横向平锉；只轻微磨圆尖角。

why: Non-acetone remover removes polish more slowly but is less likely to soften a nail tip or acrylic enhancement during routine polish removal.
无丙酮卸甲液去除甲油较慢，但在日常卸甲油时不容易软化甲片或丙烯酸人工甲。
lock: enhancement polish change = non-acetone remover.
人工甲更换甲油 = 无丙酮卸甲液。

why: A hangnail is torn, dry skin beside the nail. Cuticle oil softens that skin and helps prevent more cracking.
hangnail（倒刺）是指甲旁撕裂的干燥皮肤。甲缘油能软化皮肤，帮助防止继续开裂。
lock: hangnail care = soften dry skin with oil.
倒刺护理 = 用油软化干燥皮肤。

why: Leaving a small gap keeps striping tape away from living skin and the moving free edge. The gap helps the design stay sealed.
留出小间隙，可让装饰胶带远离活皮肤和会活动的游离缘，帮助图案保持密封。
lock: striping tape gap = 1/16 inch from each edge.
装饰胶带间隙 = 距两端各 1/16 英寸。

why: Gentle joint movement relaxes the foot before deeper massage. Starting softly also lets the technician notice pain or limited movement.
在较深层按摩前先轻柔活动关节，可放松足部，也能让美甲师发现疼痛或活动受限。
lock: foot massage starts with gentle joint movement.
足部按摩先从轻柔关节活动开始。

why: Weekly deep disinfection gives the solution more time inside the spa system. Leaving it overnight helps disinfect areas that water flows through.
每周深度消毒让消毒液在足浴系统内停留更久。过夜浸泡有助于消毒水流经过的内部区域。
lock: weekly foot-spa disinfection = leave solution overnight.
每周足浴设备消毒 = 消毒液留置过夜。

why: A manicure improves the natural nails and cares for the hands. It does not mean diagnosing or treating a nail disease.
manicure（手部美甲护理）美化天然指甲并护理双手，不包括诊断或治疗指甲疾病。
lock: manicure = hand and natural-nail care.
manicure = 手部和天然指甲护理。

why: Top coat forms the last clear layer over colored polish. It adds shine and takes wear before the color layer does.
top coat（亮油）在彩色甲油上形成最后一层透明保护膜，增加光泽，并先承受日常磨损。
lock: top coat = shine plus chip protection.
top coat = 增加光泽并防止崩裂。
refs: Manicuring - Nail Coatings and Top Coat

why: A pedicure cares for healthy feet and toenails. Treating foot disease requires a medical professional and is outside salon work.
pedicure（足部美甲护理）护理健康的足部和脚趾甲。治疗足部疾病需要医疗人员，不属于沙龙服务。
lock: pedicure = care, not disease treatment.
pedicure = 护理，不治疗疾病。

why: A curette has a small rounded scoop that can lift loose material near the nail. A sharp tool could cut living skin.
curette（刮匙）有小而圆的勺形端，可轻轻带走指甲附近的松散残留物；尖锐工具可能割伤活皮肤。
lock: curette = rounded scoop for loose nail debris.
curette = 清除松散甲周残留物的圆头小勺。

why: Friction uses firm rubbing pressure. The thick skin on the bottom of the foot can safely receive this movement during a pedicure massage.
friction（摩擦法）使用较强的摩擦压力。足底皮肤较厚，在足部按摩中可以安全使用这种动作。
lock: pedicure friction = bottom of the foot only.
足部 friction = 只用于足底。

notes: All candidates remain unreviewed. Six vague, damaged, or unsafe source items were quarantined rather than authored around.
